script:
Another speaker offered a different vantage point. Sian said he'd been physically present in Skittles' home during a Child Protective Services visit.

He had once spoken respectfully about Angela's mission. Now he was watching an official visit unfold inside somebody's home.

He couldn't identify the caller from the visit itself. But he could describe what he witnessed.

In the same September 18 broadcast, two women spoke about what they said had happened to them after falling out with Angela.

One described her legal name, phone number and residential property information being disclosed, and alleged that Angela had called her house.

Another mother said she'd faced repeated visits from child-protection workers and police, followed by calls to relatives, including her daughter.

Hear what those women describe: the phone ringing at home, visits from authorities, a daughter changing her number. Their accounts put the online dispute inside real households.

Of course, an outside accusation doesn't prove who made any particular call, and a welfare check can arise from genuine concern.

So I went looking for the way Angela herself talked about intervening in other people's lives.

In another archived broadcast called Monkey Island, Angela described consequences she says followed phone calls she'd made about other people. You'll hear me encouraging her just before she speaks.

Listen to the way Angela characterizes those consequences.

“A long line of destruction behind me for accountability.”

I can't confirm the jail time or the confiscated firearms from this recording. But I don't have to guess how Angela wanted the audience to understand her actions. She used the word destruction herself—and placed it under accountability.

In another confrontation, she went beyond describing claimed consequences. Somebody asked her directly whether she had helped disclose other people's private information.

“I absolutely did.”

Angela said people had sent her the information to provoke her. That was her explanation. But she'd just acknowledged her own participation.
title: THE PAPER TRAIL - Logan Narration Part 08 of 17
